reason: The report reproduces (coef 0.504, SE 0.222, N=1960) but it is a single cross-sectional OLS of observational data with no identification strategy, so a causal 'positive effect' claim is unsupported; the estimate also flips to about -2.1 when the post-period management rating is added as a control, showing sensitivity to specification. A descriptive association could be reported with explicit caveats, but not as a causal effect.
